name: syncnote-monorepo
description: SyncNote: An Offline-First Intelligent Knowledge Management Platform with AI-Assisted Semantic Synchronization

scripts.dev:services: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
